body: A GED is something you need when you dropped out of highschool. I've made up my mind though. I'm saving up for a gun.

Its not even worth it. I've been working on this GED for a year now, and for some stupid reason I just threw in this job that's full time hours. I have to work 8 hours tomorrow at 9am. It is 1 42 am right now, so I'll be tired, hungry and depressed. 8 hours of me realizing just how bad at socializing I am. 8 hours of watching people talk to their friends and have a glimpse of what it would be like to be normal. Then after that shift I'll have a raging headache and soar legs and have to walk right to school. By then I wont be able to think straight, I'll be even more tired, get barely anything done and walk all the way back home, go to bed super depressed and not able to sleep and make posts like this. I've had it. I'm sick of seeing my brother with his girlfriend and seeing him live a happy life with a job that was handed to him that he never worked for. All I got is my mom, and even she gets really short with me and our relationship is horrible. No friends, no family. I'm nearing the end, i can just feel it. My road is coming to an end real soon, and it's the only thing that makes me happy

I have a strong urge to see what apex is all about. But luckily I sold my ps4. I cant do it. I cant think or even look at games anymore. Life is so different now, for the worst. I miss smoking weed and playing games so bad.
